caseName: Walters v. Chicago, Burlington & Quincy Railroad
caseNameFull: Walters, Administratrix v. Chicago, Burlington & Quincy Railroad Company
summary: Error to the Circuit Court of the United States for the District of Nebraska.
attorneys: Mr. N. C. Abbott for the plaintiff in error. Mr. J. W. Deweese and Mr. Charles F. Manderson for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
.Per Curiam,

judgment affirmed, with costs, on the authority of St. Louis & San Francisco Railway Company v. James, 161 U. S. 545; Louisville &c. Railway Company v. Louisville Banking Company, 174 U. S. 552.
